name: Update_Artifact
description:
Update_Artifact creates a new version of an existing artifact. Provide either `edits` (preferred for small changes: exact find/replace pairs, each `find` must match exactly one place in the current version) or `content` (a full rewrite, for large changes).
If an edit fails, call Read_Artifact to get the current text (the user may have edited it) and retry, or send the full content.

artifact_id.description: The artifact id returned by Create_Artifact or List_Artifacts.

edits.description: Ordered exact find/replace edits applied to the current version. Include enough surrounding text in `find` to make it unique.

find.description: Exact text to find (must occur exactly once).

replace.description: Replacement text (may be empty to delete).

content.description: Full replacement content. Use instead of `edits` for large rewrites.

summary.description: Optional short description of the change, e.g. 'Added Q3 column'.
